title: ww1 music pack
description: replaces most in game music with songs used in the great war
body:
This is a texture pack that replaces most ingame music(except discs) with songs sung in ww1.
**notice none of the songs are my own**

If you would like to listen to the songs withot the pack the links are below all of which are on youtube:

GERMAN:

"Argonnerwald"- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xl8rV7DBupA

"Heil dir im Siegerkranz"- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZNox238TXp8
